unmapped.what_it_says: Institutional ban on developing or deploying agentic AI (organisational, not student use); only partly held by delegate_to_ai_agent.

notes.note: Aston is a staff/governance AI adoption policy; nothing further on student uses, misconduct or support (written approval for data disclosure is a data rule; 'Spell-check, generic content generation' is a risk-category example, not a use rule). Scope none kept, so the AI System definition was not added.

Existing row for generate_assessed_text prohibited kept alongside declaration option iii.
